text: Grandson, 2. Temperature 39. He's got a rash on his chest and back, I did the glass test and it goes pale when I press so I think that's alright? His colour's normal, lips pink, nothing off there as far as I can tell. Neck seems fine too, he was bending right down looking at his toes not ten minutes ago. I just want to know do I take him in tonight or not. Yes or no would do.
